name: Homo sapiens

estimated_percentage_range.applies_to: non-African modern populations (varies by population; see claim_neanderthal_ancestry_by_population)
Melanesian/Papuan/Aboriginal Australian populations highest (~3-6%); mainland East Asian populations much lower (~0.1-0.2%); see claim_denisovan_ancestry_by_population

notes: No single point in time can currently be identified for the species’ origin (Bergström et al. 2021); earliest fossil evidence spans multiple African sites (Jebel Irhoud, Morocco; Omo Kibish, Ethiopia), not one “cradle.”
